profile.name: Yogin Thakkar
profile.tagline: Building academic programmes that hold up to scrutiny and get students over the line.
profile.bio: A Higher Education leader working across UK and Indian institutions, specialising in programme leadership, curriculum innovation and quality assurance. As a Fellow of Advance HE (FHEA) with three master's degrees, I bring hands-on experience of programme design, validation and review, grounded in a background in financial services compliance and risk. I have built and led academic portfolios with 100% pass rates, developed teaching teams, and worked with partners and PSRBs to keep provision aligned with the UK Quality Code.
